paragraphs.source_en: The remaining timber from Kyoto's Great Buddha Hall began arriving at Osaka Castle, whose outer defenses had been utterly destroyed, shortly after Tokugawa Hidetada's departure—at the end of the first month and the beginning of the second month of the twentieth year of Keichō.
